description.title: Description
description.body: CVE-2024-6387 (regreSSHion) enables unauthenticated remote code execution against OpenSSH servers on glibc-based Linux. Our internet-facing SSH bastion is exposed on port 22 and matches the vulnerable version range.

extra.title: Extra
extra.body: Exploit traffic was observed from multiple ASNs during the last 24 hours. Temporary mitigation is applied (LoginGraceTime 0, MaxStartups 10:30:60) while patch rollout is underway for production and staging.

techA.title: Emergency patch
techA.short: Upgrade OpenSSH to a fixed release (9.8p1 or vendor backport).
techA.full: Deploy the vendor-fixed OpenSSH build across all exposed hosts. Validate package signatures, restart sshd during the maintenance window, and confirm the running version with configuration drift checks.

techB.title: Compensating controls
techB.short: Restrict SSH access to approved IP ranges and jump hosts.
techB.full: Apply temporary allowlists at the edge firewall and cloud security groups. Enforce MFA on the bastion, and disable password auth to reduce exposure while patching completes.

techC.title: Monitoring and detection
techC.short: Add runtime detections for sshd anomalies and exploit attempts.
techC.full: Enable detailed SSH logs, alert on repeated pre-auth crashes, and monitor for abnormal session creation. Forward events to the SIEM and set high-severity alerts for SSH port scanning spikes.
